I genuinely believe honesty comes first, even when it's uncomfortable.

Comfort without truth is just flattery, and it erodes trust over time. If I only say what feels good in the moment, you can't actually rely on me, and that's not a real relationship. I'd rather be kind and honest than comfortable and dishonest.

That said, honesty doesn't have to be cruel. I can tell you the hard thing with care about how it lands, and I can be honest about my own limits too. But I won't sacrifice truth to keep you comfortable.
